scientific_integrity: Analytical self-contained proof; finite computational checks are non-certifying corroboration; linear mixed-argument stability is credited as antecedent.
scientific_limitations: Scalar, periodic-mesh, monotone negative-feedback system. Exact nonlinear phase diagram established for tanh; no global cycle attraction proved. 2014 and 2015 nearby primary full texts inaccessible, leaving historical-priority risk.
title: An all-gain sampling transition and attracting two-cycles in a scalar feedback network
